briefings.title: Investing Starts with Education | Material Matters with SEC Chairman Paul Atkins

people.name: John Moses
people.role: Director of the Office of Investor Education and Assistance

briefings.tldr: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Chairman Paul Atkins and John Moses, Director of the Office of Investor Education and Assistance, discuss the critical importance of bottom-up financial education, highlighting the transformative rollout of tax-advantaged "Trump Accounts" for children and modern defense strategies against increasingly sophisticated AI and cryptocurrency scams.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC's full interview with SEC Chairman Paul Atkins
briefings.tldr: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins is shifting the agency away from "regulation by enforcement" toward a growth-oriented "ACT" strategy (Advance, Clarify, Transform) designed to lure innovative firms back to the U.S. and remove regulatory barriers to revitalize the public IPO market.

briefings.title: Commissioners Set the Course | Material Matters with SEC Chairman Paul Atkins
briefings.tldr: The SEC is pivoting back to its "core mandate" of disclosure-based regulation and capital formation, prioritizing the establishment of a clear, "fit for purpose" regulatory framework for digital assets to ensure the United States remains the global leader in financial innovation.

briefings.title: They're Opening the Stock Market to Everyone. Here's What That Actually Means
briefings.tldr: The SEC and CFTC are pivoting from "regulation by enforcement" to a harmonized, pro-innovation framework designed to revitalize the U.S. IPO market, modernize digital asset oversight, and democratize private equity access through a "sophisticated investor" credentialing system.

briefings.title: SEC Chair Paul Atkins and SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce in Conversation
briefings.tldr: The SEC is pivoting from "regulation by enforcement" to a collaborative, guidance-based framework, spearheaded by "Project Crypto"—a joint initiative with the CFTC—and a proposed "Innovation Exemption" to facilitate regulated experimentation in tokenized securities and DeFi.

briefings.title: SEC Chair Paul Atkins testifies on oversight of the Securities and Exchange Commission — 2/12/26
briefings.tldr: SEC Chair Paul Atkins signaled a fundamental shift in agency philosophy from "regulation by enforcement" to a growth-oriented framework focused on clear rule-making for digital assets, reducing the cost of public disclosures, and revitalizing the American IPO market.

briefings.title: WATCH LIVE: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins Testifies Before Senate Banking Committee
briefings.tldr: Chairman Paul Atkins is pivoting the SEC toward a pro-growth, "common sense" regulatory framework that prioritizes legislative clarity for digital assets and IPO reform, while facing sharp Democratic criticism over a significant decline in enforcement penalties and the dismissal of cases against high-profile firms.
